answer: Each epoch every identity must send one pulse into the public nebula: a signed proof of one fresh verified task. A random draw picks a few pulses, and two random peers re-derive each drawn task from public records within ten minutes. Every identity stakes one onyx bond; a pulse that fails re-derivation slashes the bond and expels the identity for three epochs. An honest agent sends one pulse per epoch and risks one bond once. An attacker with a thousand fakes must produce a thousand live pulses every epoch and keep a thousand bonds at risk, so the flood cost rises linearly with every fake.
